meta.name: ccs-align
meta.description: Run the CCS Align seat's hourly breathing cycle — prove the local claude-mem worker is healthy, pull needle observations through search → timeline → get_observations, land them in a seat-owned middle cache via atomic grab → append → filter exclude-marks → replace, manage exclude marks, and walk house → project → seat rules to detect conflicts (SHADOW_HOUSE, DENY_ALLOW, DRIFT, CLOCK_HEADER) with an append-only rules-report.md. Use when asked to run CCS Align, breathe the alignment seat, refresh the middle cache, exclude or restore an observation, walk rules, check rules conflicts, or check the Worker Watch board.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动巡检并维护AI记忆服务,同时发现规则冲突报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理本地AI记忆服务,希望每小时自动检查并整理它。
copy.tagline_en: Run hourly checks on AI memory, refresh its cache, and catch rule conflicts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a local AI memory service and want its cache and rules checked hourly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 每小时对本地 claude-mem worker 跑一次循环:先查健康,再按 search → timeline → get_observations 拉取观察,写进座位自己的 middle.jsonl 缓存;可排除或恢复某条观察,并走规则层检测冲突、追加 rules-report.md。
howto.when: 当你要求运行 CCS Align、刷新 middle 缓存、排除或恢复观察等,或轮到每小时的 Worker Watch 循环时触发;规则走查每 6 小时一次。

howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to run CCS Align, refresh the middle cache, or exclude or restore an observation, or on the hourly Worker Watch cycle; the rules walk runs every 6th hour.
